scientific.integrity: The vanilla FedNova rule and its default effective local-step scaling are specialized exactly to two deterministic equal-weight scalar quadratics. The chosen client step reaches each local minimizer exactly in one step, so the resulting affine round map and its stability frontier are exact.
limitations: Two equal-weight scalar clients with identical positive curvature.
Deterministic full participation and vanilla local gradient descent.
Constant client step eta=1/a and the source default effective server scale.
No claim for stochastic gradients, partial participation, momentum, alternative server scales, or noncommuting vector Hessians.

title: FedNova has a sharp local-step-imbalance instability on exact local solves
